card.name: Linking words before lab-value thresholds
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'in', 'above' or 'and' that sit between a measurement or effect and the term that follows. Typical settings are 'times the upper limit of normal' and 'decrease in gastrointestinal motility'.

modes.label: Times the upper limit
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'above' right after a multiple, leading into 'upper limit of normal'.
modes.example: increases in CPK values to greater than 10 times<< the>> upper limit of normal

modes.label: Change in a body function
modes.description: A linking word such as 'in' or 'reduced' before a body function or test result in drug interaction text.
modes.example: apparently due to a decrease<< in>> gastrointestinal motility and the stomach emptying

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before a lab result or body-function term, such as 'times the upper limit of normal'.
